usage: 白色 (white) can be used as a noun to refer to the color white.
It can also function as an adjective to describe something that is white in color.
When using 白色 as an adjective, it usually appears before the noun it modifies.
In Cantonese, the color 白色 can describe clothing, objects, or even abstract things like paper or snow.
